about: What the character controller must get right, a row a criterion (tools/controller/README.md, docs/controller.md's production criteria): what a player notices, its bar and source, the check that measures it, cheap (the plain-Rust course, seconds) or heavy (the in-game film, a bench), whether it is measurable yet. `noticed` is how much a player notices it, 5 most; the scorecard orders failing rows by it (the task list). `course` names the test that drives the mover through terra_motion::course and prints its numbers.

criteria.notice: a body driven fast at a wall one voxel thick ends up in it or through it
criteria.unit: of 8 speeds, 2-60 m/s
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 1; Jolt (swept move); ours for the SDF sweep

criteria.notice: a body driven fast at another passes through it
criteria.unit: of 8 speeds, 2-60 m/s

criteria.notice: two bodies closing fast (a fall, a charge, a knockback) pass through each other in a tick
criteria.unit: of 12 meetings (head on, at a glance, one falling onto another; closing at 10-60 m/s) where the cores met
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 1; D53; Jolt's continuous collision (PhysicsSystem's CCD: a fast body cast along its motion relative to the other's)

criteria.notice: a body driven fast at a door passes through it
criteria.unit: of 8 speeds

criteria.notice: a body's capsule sinks into the ground, a wall or a roof
criteria.unit: m
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 2; Jolt (tolerance 1 mm, padding 2 cm)

criteria.notice: a body's capsule sits a little into what it touches
criteria.unit: m
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 2; Jolt (tolerance 1 mm, padding 2 cm)

criteria.notice: a slope too steep is walked up, or one shallow enough stops the body
criteria.unit: deg off the kind's limit
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 3; Jolt's limit; our data (50 deg for a man)

criteria.notice: a body stopped by ground too steep to climb, still pressed into it, is said to move at its jog: its figure strides in place
criteria.unit: m/s, the worst of the slopes that stop it
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 3; Unreal's walking velocity reflects the move made (PhysWalking), Lyra's pose reads it

criteria.notice: a body goes up a hill as fast as on the flat
criteria.unit: of the kind's curve
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 4; player.md, slopes slow you

criteria.notice: a step the body should walk up stops it, or one too high is walked up
criteria.unit: of 10 steps wrong
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 5; Jolt WalkStairs; our one rule (0.55 m for a man)

criteria.notice: a base's step is climbed by a different rule than the ground's
criteria.unit: steps wrong

criteria.notice: a prop's top is climbed by a different rule than the ground's
criteria.unit: steps wrong

criteria.notice: a rock or log is climbed by a different rule than the ground's
criteria.unit: steps wrong

criteria.notice: a stump or log taller than a step is climbed by way of its roots, or from a slope's high side
criteria.unit: walks wrong

criteria.notice: a step pops the body up in one frame
criteria.unit: of the step a frame, the shown figure or the camera, the worst step up of the filmed course at a jog and a sprint

criteria.notice: sprinting down a 45 deg slope the body leaves the ground and floats
criteria.unit: airborne ticks

criteria.notice: sprinting down a stair of 0.3 m steps the body hops off each one
criteria.unit: airborne ticks

criteria.notice: walking up a flight of steps is slower than walking on the level, or faster
criteria.unit: of the kind's jog off it, worst flight (steps 0.1-0.5 m: the ground's, a base's whole, half and stair cubes)
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criteria 5 and 6; Jolt WalkStairs, Unreal StepUp (horizontal speed kept), Enshrouded

criteria.notice: walking up a flight of steps the body leaves the ground or slides at each step's edge
criteria.unit: ticks not grounded climbing, all flights
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criteria 5 and 6; Jolt WalkStairs, Unreal StepUp

criteria.notice: walking down a flight of steps is slower than walking on the level, or faster
criteria.unit: of the kind's jog off it, worst flight

criteria.notice: stepping through a doorway onto a floor a little over the ground the body hops
criteria.unit: m over the higher of ground and floor, worst of sills 0-0.1 m
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criteria 5 and 6; Unreal StepUp and floor snapping

criteria.notice: walking into a doorway onto its threshold, the body stops at the wall under the lintel
criteria.unit: m short of 1 m past the wall, worst of thresholds 0.1-0.5 m (12, each from 5 starts 1 cm apart) under a lintel 2 m over the floor
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criteria 5 and 6; Jolt WalkStairs, Unreal StepUp (both rise the whole step)

criteria.notice: jogging at a lump of ground lower than a step, its foot too steep to stand on (the filmed yard's), the body stops at its foot and walks round it
criteria.unit: walks stopped short, of 60 (lumps 0.3-0.4 m high with feet 60-66 deg, 4 lines across, 5 starts 1 cm apart)
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criteria 1 and 5; Jolt CharacterVirtual (CancelVelocityTowardsSteepSlopes only for a slope it cannot walk, after WalkStairs)

criteria.notice: a jump in a 2 m tunnel puts the head into the roof
criteria.unit: m

criteria.notice: a jump into a roof keeps rising instead of stopping
criteria.unit: m/s up on contact

criteria.notice: a body falling on a round world lands off the line to its centre
criteria.unit: m

criteria.notice: a body on a round world stands tilted from the line to its centre
criteria.unit: deg

criteria.notice: a jump goes higher or lower than its launch speed and gravity say
criteria.unit: m off v²/2g

criteria.notice: a jump pressed just after running off a ledge is lost
criteria.unit: s off the kind's coyote time
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 10; the platformer convention; our data (0.1 s)

criteria.notice: a jump pressed just before landing is lost
criteria.unit: s off the kind's buffer
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 10; the platformer convention; our data (0.15 s)

criteria.notice: a body that has touched down is not grounded yet
criteria.unit: ticks

criteria.notice: a body bounces on landing
criteria.unit: m

criteria.notice: a landing's speed is not reported, or is not the fall's, so a fall cannot hurt
criteria.unit: every drop's within a tick of gravity of sqrt(2gh)

criteria.notice: a jump, a step or a flight of stairs down, or a short drop hurts
criteria.unit: harm (shares of health) summed over a jump in place, steps 0.1-0.8 and 1.5 m down, a flight of 0.3 m stairs and drops short of the onset, two kinds

criteria.notice: a fall a little short of the kind's onset hurts, one a little past it does not, or one past the fatal speed leaves the body alive
criteria.unit: of 8 drops 3% either side of the onset and the fatal speed, two kinds, judged wrong

criteria.notice: a longer fall hurts less than a shorter one
criteria.unit: steps of drops 1-30 m by 0.5 m, two kinds, where the harm falls, or does not rise between the onset and the fatal speed

criteria.notice: a fall onto a slope hurts as much as one onto level ground, though the slope takes some of it
criteria.unit: of 4 drops onto a 40 deg slope judged wrong: 5% past the onset harmless, 3% past the fatal speed hurt but alive

criteria.notice: a fall into water deep enough to swim in hurts
criteria.unit: harm (shares of health) summed over drops of 5-30 m into water 6 m deep and just deep enough to swim in, two kinds

criteria.notice: the body starts moving a tick or more after the key is pressed
criteria.unit: ticks

criteria.notice: every kind gets up to speed alike, whatever its file says
criteria.unit: ticks off the kind's data (to top speed, and back to standing)

criteria.notice: every kind turns alike, whatever its file says
criteria.unit: ticks off the kind's data

criteria.notice: two kinds whose files differ move alike
criteria.unit: results alike of those the two kinds' data set apart

criteria.notice: steering in the air is stronger or weaker than the kind's data
criteria.unit: of the kind's fraction

criteria.notice: bodies stand inside each other in a crowd
criteria.unit: m, a pair with a hard body after a tick, and the crowd's soft pairs once it has stood a second
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 15; movement.md duel bar; D479

criteria.notice: a man shoves a body four times his weight as far as it shoves him
criteria.unit: off the mass ratio

criteria.notice: a body that holds its place is shoved
criteria.unit: m

criteria.notice: two people standing in each other snap apart at once, or stay in each other
criteria.unit: ticks off ln 20 of the kind's soft_s for a 20 cm overlap of two men to fall under 1 cm
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 15; D479; Detour dtCrowd collision handling (zlib)

criteria.notice: a person standing in the way stops a walker dead (D479: people never block)
criteria.unit: of the walk with no one there lost, worst of a man jogged past one standing 0.05-0.5 m to the side for 1.5 s
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 15; D479; Detour dtCrowd collision handling (zlib)

criteria.notice: a person standing is shoved farther than out of the way of someone walking past
criteria.unit: of the way out of the walker's path (both radii less how far aside it stood) the one standing is moved, worst of the same walks
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 15; D479; Detour dtCrowd collision handling (zlib)

criteria.notice: a monster is held up by the men in its way (D479: monsters push hard)
criteria.unit: of its walk alone lost, a monster (400 kg, hard) walked 2 s through a line of five men 0.8 m apart, two shifts
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 15; D479; Detour dtCrowd collision handling (zlib)

criteria.notice: a man pushes a monster farther than his share of their mass, or not at all
criteria.unit: off the mass share, the monster's speed over the man's jog, a man walking head on into it for a second
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 15; D479; Detour dtCrowd collision handling (zlib)

criteria.notice: a body is pushed into or through a wall
criteria.unit: m into the wall (1 through), worst body of a monster walking a man into a wall, two offsets
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 15; D479; Detour dtCrowd collision handling (zlib)

criteria.notice: a body squeezes through a gap narrower than itself, or is stopped by one wide enough
criteria.unit: of 6 gaps wrong

criteria.notice: deep water is a wall the body cannot walk into
a body walking into a lake, across it and out stops in the water or at the far shore
criteria.unit: m short of the far shore's dry ground, worst walk (shores to 12 and 25 deg, straight across and 25 and 45 deg off), given 1.5 times the walk at the kind's jog and swim
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 17 and the sources table (water a medium, not a contact); D74

criteria.notice: a body wading in swims before the water is as deep as its kind's swim depth, or wades on deeper
criteria.unit: m off the kind's swim depth (swim_depth x height) where it first leaves its feet going in, worst walk
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 17, 'Numbers that are data' (swim depth); D74

criteria.notice: a body wading does not slow with the water's depth, or slows by other than the kind's rule
criteria.unit: m/s off the rule (jog x (1 - (1 - wade) x depth / swim depth) wading, swim speed deeper), worst of a jog on level ground under still water 0.025 to 1.375 of the swim depth, for a man and the second kind
criteria.source: D523 (wading slows linearly to 60% of a jog at swimming depth); docs/controller.md criterion 17

criteria.notice: a body's speed steps down from a jog to a swim as the water deepens
criteria.unit: m/s, the largest change of speed between consecutive depths (a twentieth of the swim depth apart) jogged into, from ankle deep to past the swim depth, for a man and the second kind
criteria.source: D523 (no step from a jog to a swim)

criteria.notice: a swimmer walks or stands upright in the water instead of treading upright, stroking along the surface and diving along its way
criteria.unit: share of the filmed lake's swimming frames (half a second after each start, stop or change of clip not judged) whose figure shows no swim clip, or whose torso (pelvis to neck) lies over 15 deg from up treading or from the way it goes stroking or diving
criteria.source: docs/controller.md 'What is presentation' (the swim pose); D478; Unreal's and BotW's swimmers tilted by their pitch

criteria.notice: a body in deep water sinks or does not float up to the surface
criteria.unit: m off the kind's float depth (float_depth x height under the surface), put 3 m under and left 8 s
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 17, 'Numbers that are data' (buoyancy); D74

criteria.notice: a swimmer moving while looking down does not dive, dives at a rate its look does not set, or a camera resting a little under level takes it under; or holding jump does not rise
criteria.unit: share of the kind's dive (vertical) or swim (level) speed off, worst stroke: forward looking 10-70 deg down from afloat, read over a second after the first, against dive x sin and swim x cos of the look past the kind's dive_from_deg (stretched so straight down stays straight down); and jump held from 8 m under, against dive; two kinds

criteria.notice: a swimmer holding jump, or let alone, does not come back up to the surface
criteria.unit: m off the kind's float depth, worst of: jump held from 8 m under for the way up at its dive rate and 2 s; nothing held from 8 m under for 10 s; two kinds

criteria.notice: a swimmer at the surface goes under, or bobs more and more
criteria.unit: m the mouth (the kind's mouth x height) went under the surface, swimming forward 8 s afloat looking level, 0.08 rad down (the camera's rest) and 2 deg short of the kind's dive_from_deg, and the last 4 s of 10 floating up from 8 m under; plus m the bob's span grew from the first half of the time to the second; two kinds

criteria.notice: breath is used above water or not under it, runs out sooner or later than the kind's, does not drown, or does not come back at the surface
criteria.unit: share off, worst span: breath gone breath_s after the mouth (judged by the surface) went under, dead drown_s after, full again breath_back_s of time out after drowning (what bobs under spend added back); and breath used afloat 1.5 breath_s; plus a tick's worth a tick it fell with the mouth out or rose under; two kinds

criteria.notice: a diver on a lake's bed sinks into it, floats off it while stroking down, or is slowed by it
criteria.unit: m, worst of: deepest the feet went under the bed, how far over the bed (less the kind's padding) it ends, and how far short of its stroke's level speed (swim x cos) it went along the bed in 4 s, diving at 60 deg into a pool 11.8 m deep; two kinds

criteria.notice: a diver swimming toward a shore does not come out of the water onto it
criteria.unit: m short of 0.5 m past the far shore's dry ground, dived 1.5 s at 60 deg in the lake (2.3 m deep), then forward level up a 12 and a 25 deg shore, given 1.5 times the way at the kind's swim speed; two kinds

criteria.notice: a swimmer swimming into a bank no higher over the water than its kind's climb-out limit does not climb out onto it
criteria.unit: share of banks 0.35, 0.7 and 0.9 of the kind's climb_out over deep water, swum into from the surface straight and 30 deg off, it does not end standing on; given 1.5 times the way at the kind's swim speed and 3 s; two kinds
criteria.source: D523 (a swimmer climbs out onto a ledge up to about 1 m over the water, as Unreal's water jump does); docs/controller.md criterion 17

criteria.notice: a swimmer climbs out onto a bank higher over the water than its kind's climb-out limit
criteria.unit: share of banks 1.2 and 1.5 of the kind's climb_out over deep water, swum into as swim.ledge, it ends standing on; two kinds
criteria.source: D523 (up to about 1 m); Unreal's MaxOutOfWaterStepHeight

criteria.notice: a body walking into a cliff, a dug pit's side, a base's wall, a rock or a trunk cannot climb it, or holds walkable ground, a step or another body as a face
criteria.unit: of 16 walks (a sheer wall, a cliff dug in 0.5 m cells, a base's wall of cubes, a rock, a trunk: climbed 1 m; a 40 deg slope, a face 0.7 of a step, a body standing: never held; two kinds)

criteria.notice: a face of a material that cannot be held (ice, glass, plaster) is climbed, or grip does not scale the cost
criteria.unit: of 6 faces by material (a face of no grip walked into and jumped at: never held; held still on one of grip 0.5: twice the cost within 1%; two kinds)

criteria.notice: a climb does not start when a body jumps at a face or pushes into it, or starts sooner than half a second's push
criteria.unit: of 8 starts (a jump at a sheer wall held within a tick of touching it; a walk into it held 0.5 s after touching, within a tick; straight and 20 deg off; two kinds)

criteria.notice: a body in a fight stance grabs a face it is pushed into
criteria.unit: of 4 starts in a fight stance that held the face (walked into a sheer wall and jumped at it; two kinds)

criteria.notice: a climber cannot pull itself onto a top, or a ledge in reach from a jump, or pulls itself into a gap too low to stand in
criteria.unit: of 8 tops (a 3 m wall climbed, ledges 0.7 and 0.9 of the hands' reach jumped at: standing on top; a ledge under a roof 0.6 of the body's height over it: never stood on; two kinds)
criteria.source: D508 (about 2.2 m over a man's feet); docs/controller.md, "Climbing"; Unreal's ledge test

criteria.notice: a climber goes up a sheer face much faster or slower than its kind's speed
criteria.unit: share off a man's 1 m/s, his feet's speed along the face between 2 and 5 m up a 12 m wall

criteria.notice: a face less steep is not climbed faster, or an overhang not slower
criteria.unit: of 4 pairs out of order (faces 70, 90 and 110 deg from level, the speed along each between 1 and 3 m up; two kinds)

criteria.notice: a body hangs under an overhang past the limit or a ceiling, or cannot hold a slight one
criteria.unit: of 14 faces (0, 15, 25 deg past vertical held and climbed 0.5 m; 35, 45, 60 never held; a ceiling jumped into never held; two kinds)

criteria.notice: a climb jump's lunge rises much more or less than its kind's
criteria.unit: m off a man's 1.5 m, his feet's rise over 1.5 s after a jump with the stick up, 1 m up a sheer wall

criteria.notice: jumping with the stick away from a face does not leave it
criteria.unit: of 2 kick-offs (1 m up a sheer wall, not holding, aloft and moving away over 1 m/s 0.2 s after; two kinds)

criteria.notice: climbing, holding, an overhang or a lunge costs other than the kind's stamina, or a climber with none left keeps holding
criteria.unit: worst share off the kind's cost over a second held 1 m up (holding a quarter of moving, on a sheer face and 15 deg past vertical, an overhang twice; a lunge its lump and holding), or ticks past one from none to letting go held still, and 1 if it took hold again with none; two kinds

criteria.notice: a staggering blow does not knock a climber off its face
criteria.unit: of 2 blows (1 m up a sheer wall, the stick still into it) that left the climber holding a tick later, or holding again before it stood; two kinds

criteria.notice: a climber is held off a face or into it, across a dug cliff's steps
criteria.unit: m, the worst a climber's capsule is off its kind's climb_gap from the ground (sampled every 2.5 cm of its axis) while it climbs the dug cliff of 0.5 m cells and a sheer wall, from a quarter second after taking hold until its hands near the top; two kinds
criteria.source: docs/controller.md, "Climbing" (within 1 cm of climb_gap; criterion 2's 1 cm)

criteria.notice: a climber climbing down onto the floor does not stand on it at once, or is hurt
criteria.unit: ticks past one from the feet reaching the floor to standing on it, and landings that hurt (climbing down 1 m of a sheer wall; two kinds)

criteria.notice: many bodies climbing slow the server's tick
criteria.unit: µs a body a climbing tick, the worst of a man climbing the course's sheer wall, dug cliff and base's wall in the mover's release bench (movement_bench_climb.rs)

criteria.notice: sprinting, jumping or swimming costs more or less than the kind's data
criteria.unit: of the kind's cost
criteria.needs: stamina carried through the course's mover trait, with the kind's costs as data (stage 2)

criteria.notice: two machines see a crowd end in different places
criteria.unit: of 5 reruns different
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 19; D51, D138; reruns: again, bodies given reversed, interleaved, ticked on 5 and on 16 threads

criteria.notice: far from the world's origin a body pops off the ground, sticks or strays walking where it walks fine near it
criteria.unit: ticks of 4 walks at 30 km off the ground or over 10 cm (a tick at a sprint) from the same walk at 2 km
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 22; D482, Jolt's large worlds (Docs/BigWorlds.md); level, 20 deg up and down, 0.3 m steps

criteria.notice: far from the world's origin a body's feet jitter over the ground
criteria.unit: m, the foot's gap to the ground at 30 km against 2 km's, worst tick

criteria.notice: a body far from the world's origin costs more than one near it
criteria.unit: field calls a tick at 30 km over 2 km's, the same 4 walks
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 22; D482 (f32 noise at 30 km: 528 calls a tick against 140)

criteria.notice: many bodies moving slow the server's tick
criteria.unit: µs a body a tick

criteria.notice: a much-dug world slows every body
criteria.unit: µs a body a tick on the 2 km planet with 10,000 edits made (9 in 10 spread over 3 km, 1 in 10 within 60 m of the walk)
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 20; D21, D52; handoff controller-stage2.md Unit F2 (a sample scans every edit) and Unit V

criteria.notice: walking through the forest makes frames hitch
criteria.unit: µs a body a tick, the walk scene's route among the lush yard's trees and rocks
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 20; D52, D138; unit C2 (the walk scene's p99 14 -> 23 ms)

criteria.notice: a crowd of a thousand moving slows the server's tick
criteria.unit: ms a tick, 1,000 bodies on 8 threads (the server's cores assumed, movement_bench_crowd.rs THREADS)
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 20; D52, D138; the bench's crowd: a thousand men walking through each other on the planet at 30 km

criteria.notice: a clip file the game's bodies play has lost its baked foot locks (re-exported without them): every body's feet slide
criteria.unit: of the game's clip files whose baked foot-lock markers are missing or not what markers.ts bakes now
criteria.source: D455 (the baked lock curves); combat round 25's re-export of fight.glb dropped them

criteria.notice: the sprinting figure's stride is far too short for its speed: its legs churn too fast, or its locked feet stretch the legs and let go early
criteria.unit: the worst gait (Jog_Fwd_Loop at jog, Sprint_Loop at sprint, the base height) as the figure shows it (pace::gait): the larger of its play rate and stride warp distance from 1, or of the speed its shown stride leaves uncovered
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 21c; D455; Unreal's sync groups and stride warping, Lyra's locomotion (a clip at its gait's speed, a capped play rate)

criteria.notice: feet slide over the ground at walk, jog or sprint, or in starts, stops and turns
criteria.unit: m, the worst planted foot's travel on the filmed course, turns in place left to turn.foot (the duel's feet sliding check, its contact read from the ball over the world's ground)

criteria.notice: feet slide as the body turns in place
criteria.unit: m, the worst planted foot's travel while the body turns 20 deg or more going under 0.2 m, on the filmed course (the duel's feet sliding check)

criteria.notice: the feet shuffle after the body has stopped instead of stopping with it
criteria.unit: s, the worst stop on the filmed course: from the body standing to the last frame a ball of a foot moves over 5 mm (a stop clip's last plant lands as its distance curve reaches zero; a blend to the idle leaves the rule's settle step a quarter second on)
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 21d; Lyra's distance-matched stops; ALS's stops; D455

criteria.notice: a foot is shuffled into place by rule as the body stops, not stepped by a stop
criteria.unit: feet stepped by D455's rule (`stepping`) in each stop on the filmed course, from 0.3 s before the body stands until it next moves or turns, both paces summed
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 21d; Paragon's and ALS's per-foot stops; D455; D528

criteria.notice: a foot is dragged and then hopped forward as the body starts off
criteria.unit: feet stepped by D455's rule (a foot the clip left behind, `stepping`) in the first second of each straight start off standing on the filmed course, both paces summed
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 21d; Lyra's distance-matched starts; ALS's starts; D455

criteria.notice: the feet shuffle round by rule as the body turns from standing or slow, not as a turn is stepped
criteria.unit: feet stepped by D455's rule in each turn of 45 deg or more with the body under 1 m/s at some frame of it (a turn in place, a start or stop that turns, a pivot) and half a second on, on the filmed course, both paces summed
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 21d; Lyra's turn-in-place clips, ALS's rotate-in-place and pivots; D455

criteria.notice: a planted foot floats over a lower step or sinks into a higher one or a slope
criteria.unit: m, the worst locked plant's median of its sole off where its clip has it: the heel's and ball's height over the world's ground (sampled down from them, not foot placement's probe) against their height over the clip's own flat ground, the worse of the two, on the filmed course
criteria.source: docs/movement.md stage 4 (feet on slopes within 2 cm); Unreal Foot Placement, ALS foot IK; D455

criteria.notice: a foot is planted in the air and hangs there
criteria.unit: m, the worst locked plant's first frame: its sole's lower point (heel or ball) over the world's ground, less where that point rests on level ground, on the filmed course
criteria.source: D455 (the lock curves' 7 cm height gate); ALS FootLock

criteria.notice: a planted foot sinks into a step or a slope
criteria.unit: m, the worst locked frame's heel or ball under where its clip has it over the world's ground, on the filmed course
criteria.source: docs/movement.md stage 4; Unreal Foot Placement, ALS foot IK; D455

criteria.notice: a foot on a lower step hangs short of it, the leg straight
criteria.unit: m, p95 over locked frames of the shortfall foot placement adds to a leg (its shortfall from the goal it is bent to, less the lock's goal's alone, so the lock's own strain is not counted), on the filmed course
criteria.source: docs/movement.md stage 4; ALS pelvis offset, Unreal's MaxExtensionRatio; D455

criteria.notice: a foot on a lower step hangs short of it, the leg straight
criteria.unit: m, the worst locked frame's shortfall foot placement adds to a leg (pelvis.drop's), on the filmed course
criteria.source: docs/movement.md stage 4; ALS pelvis offset, Unreal's MaxExtensionRatio; D455

criteria.notice: what passes on the plain course fails in the game, on dug ground and a base
criteria.unit: criteria failing a pace: every mark reached, never stuck, never through the ground, the steep mound never climbed, every step settled
